title: Won-Hyo

symbol.name: Won-Hyo
symbol.meaning: The monk Wonhyo · ITF pattern 4 of 24

note.p: Won-Hyo was the monk who brought Buddhism to the Silla court in 686. The diagram is I. You start feet together in the middle of the A–B line facing D: twin forearm blocks, inward knife-hand strikes and side punches to B and A; a bending ready stance and side kick down the stem, three knife-hand guarding blocks and a fingertip thrust; the same block, strike and punch to E and F; then back up toward C with circular blocks, low kicks and punches, a second side kick, and two forearm guarding blocks where you began.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (28 movements, one technique each). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far line. Finish by bringing the right foot back to close ready stance A.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance A: feet together, the left hand wrapped over the right fist in front of the body.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin forearm block.
In the same stance, right knife-hand high inward strike, the left fist drawn back in front of the right shoulder.
Slip the left foot forward toward B into a left fixed stance. Left middle side punch.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin forearm block.
In the same stance, left knife-hand high inward strike, the right fist drawn back in front of the left shoulder.
Slip the right foot forward toward A into a right fixed stance. Right middle side punch.

Bring the right foot to the left foot and turn the head to face D, standing on the bent right leg with the left foot lifted beside the knee, side-on to D: right bending ready stance A, arms in the forearm guarding position.
Left middle side piercing kick toward D.
Set the left foot down toward D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a right L-stance (left foot forward). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust, the left hand under the right elbow, with a kihap.
Turn 270° to the left: move the left foot round to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin forearm block.
In the same stance, right knife-hand high inward strike, the left fist drawn back in front of the right shoulder.
Slip the left foot forward toward E into a left fixed stance. Left middle side punch.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to F into a left L-stance facing F (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin forearm block.
In the same stance, left knife-hand high inward strike, the right fist drawn back in front of the left shoulder.
Slip the right foot forward toward F into a right fixed stance. Right middle side punch.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot toward C into a left walking stance facing C. Right inner forearm circular block toward CF.
Right low front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Set the right foot down toward C into a right walking stance. Left middle punch.
In the same stance, left inner forearm circular block toward CE.
Left low front snap kick toward C, the hands held where they were.
Set the left foot down toward C into a left walking stance. Right middle punch.
Turn the head to face C and draw up into a left bending ready stance A, side-on to C: standing on the bent left leg, the right foot lifted beside the knee, arms in the forearm guarding position.
Right middle side piercing kick toward C.

Land the right foot on the C–D line, then turn counter-clockwise and move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
